title: How Long Do You Have Left To Live?
summary: Forty everyday choices across five fast rounds shape a playful age estimate and reveal the energy behind your current routine.

landing.intro:
One surprising result.
How far will your clock run?

about.body:
This forty-question quiz moves through five quick lifestyle rounds covering your daily rhythm, energy, pressure, spontaneity and outlook on the future. Together, those choices create a playful age estimate and personality-style clock profile.

Each round adds another layer to the reading. Your answers build a pattern across the full journey, while the final instinct question can shift the displayed estimate by no more than one year.

The quiz does not use your current age, medical records, family history, clinical research or an individual risk assessment. The result is an entertainment mechanic based only on the forty choices made during this attempt.

steps: Choose the answer that feels closest to your real routine without overthinking it.
Complete five quick rounds of eight questions; every round sharpens the estimate.
Reveal your playful age estimate, clock profile and choice-by-choice breakdown.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and self-reflection only. This quiz does not predict lifespan, health, mortality risk or medical outcomes. If you have health concerns, speak to a qualified healthcare professional.

centenarian_energy.title: Centenarian Energy
centenarian_energy.copy: Your answers suggest steady routines, everyday movement and small choices that are easy to repeat. You make consistency feel natural rather than restrictive.

steady_long_game.title: The Steady Long Game
steady_long_game.copy: Your routine has practical, sustainable energy. You tend to favour choices that keep life moving without demanding a dramatic reinvention.

balanced_realist.title: The Balanced Realist
balanced_realist.copy: Your answers blend sensible habits with enough flexibility to keep life enjoyable. You know consistency matters, but perfection is not required.

weekend_chaos.title: Weekend Chaos Mode
weekend_chaos.copy: Your choices carry bright, spontaneous energy. The plan may change, but you usually leave with a story worth telling.

stress_sprinter.title: The Stress Sprinter
stress_sprinter.copy: You can move quickly when pressure rises, sometimes at the expense of recovery. Your strongest upgrade would be better pacing, not less ambition.

comfort_creature.title: The Comfort Creature
comfort_creature.copy: You value familiarity, ease and a dependable place to recharge. Your sweet spot is comfortable living with just enough novelty and movement.

adventure_fuse.title: Adventure Fuse
adventure_fuse.copy: Your answers have curious, say-yes energy. You are drawn to fresh experiences, movement and the possibility that an ordinary day could become memorable.

reset_needed.title: Reset Needed
reset_needed.copy: Your routine appears to be asking for fewer small fires and more room to recover. A calmer rhythm may feel more useful than another ambitious overhaul.
